decisions.statement: The tree is read from the pages rather than from folders on disk.
A topic naming no topic above that topic is the root.
A topic reaches the topic above whether or not it names that topic's page type.
Topics without one root between those topics are refused rather than read as empty.
The topics under one topic are read in the order their folders sort.
A topic already open above itself is left out rather than followed again.
A node is named by its slug rather than by where its file sits.
A topic naming several topics above that topic hangs under the first that topic names.
A chevron parts each name in a label from the next.
A title is the last name in a label.

definition: the topic pages read into the tree they name, each with its coverage and status
